title: Hearty Silky Venezuelan Myeolchi-Anchovies Pilaf
description: Salty, silky, one-pot venezuelan dish featuring myeolchi-anchovies, rest, no-onion-no-garlic-friendly, vessel=scallop-shell. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat in a large scallop shell.
Add 1 tsp of ground cumin, 1 tsp of ground oregano, and 1 tsp of ground cilantro and saut	until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add 1/2 cup of myeolchi-anchovies and stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of rice and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water, 2 tablespoons of tomato paste, 1 tsp of salt, and 1/4 tsp of black pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with dried chopped scallions, if desired.
Transfer any leftovers to an airtight container and refrigerate for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
